definitions.explanation: Characters printed or written with thick strokes, used for emphasis in text; also, a thick-tipped pen or brush stroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{太字|ふとじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Put the important parts in bold.

examples.japanese: {太字|ふとじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ます→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The parts in bold will be on the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{太字|ふとじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The letters on the sign are written thick so they can be read even from far away.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太字|ふとじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make bold
- {太字|ふとじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in thick letters
- {太字|ふとじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧: a thick-tipped pen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {細字|ほそじ}: thin lettering, a fine-tipped pen (the opposite)
- ボールド: bold (the word used in software menus)
